name: Shining Strand
summary: Along Silverpine’s eastern shore, Shining Strand runs south beside Lordamere Lake toward Alterac’s rugged foothills. Vile Fin murlocs hold settlements in its shallows, making the coast dangerous for unseasoned travelers.

sections.title: A Contested Coastline
sections.body: Shining Strand runs along Silverpine Forest’s eastern edge beside Lordamere Lake. Several aggressive Vile Fin murloc settlements line the shallows and threaten travelers on the lake road. Feral worgen roam the deep woods behind the shore.

sections.title: Alchemical Harvest
sections.body: The Royal Apothecary Society has turned its attention to Shining Strand and the neighboring waters. The late Apothecary Berard recorded unusual hardened tumors harvested from local Vile Fin murlocs. He theorized that their corrupted anatomy could make the tumors a valuable catalyst for concocting a new plague for Sylvanas Windrunner’s fledgling nation.

faq.q: Where is the Shining Strand located?
faq.answer: Shining Strand runs along Silverpine Forest’s eastern shore beside Lordamere Lake. It stretches south from the Ruins of Lordaeron to the rugged hills separating Silverpine from the Alterac Mountains.

faq.q: What threats are found along the Shining Strand?
faq.answer: Several Vile Fin murloc settlements line the shore, and the murlocs attack unwary travelers. Feral worgen prowl the Silverpine woods beyond the strand.

faq.q: Why is the Royal Apothecary Society interested in this area?
faq.answer: The Royal Apothecary Society is interested because the late Apothecary Berard documented hardened tumors in local Vile Fin murlocs with unique physiological traits. He theorized the growths could be a catalyst for concocting a new plague.
The Vile Fin are the murloc tribe whose settlements line Shining Strand, making the lakeshore dangerous for unseasoned travelers.

angles.text: The Royal Apothecary Society studies Shining Strand’s Vile Fin murlocs in hopes of concocting a new plague.
Lordamere Lake’s shore links Silverpine’s northern approaches with passages toward the Alterac Mountains, though the strand is perilous.
